previousRule: The My Home checkout API rejected an otherwise valid reviewed order unless the request contained measurementsConfirmed: true. The cart no longer showed a confirmation checkbox, but its JavaScript silently supplied that flag. A direct request without it returned a generic input error.
newRule: Treat the Order now action and valid current review as the cart-level confirmation. Do not require or send the removed top-level measurementsConfirmed field, while respecting an explicit false value. Continue revalidating each product specification, stock, current price, review identity and idempotency key. Pass the internal confirmation to the existing product checkout contracts after those checks succeed.
reason: A post-release live test proved the shared-fabric order could be quoted and purchased through the browser, but a request omitting the old checkbox field failed before checkout. The owner explicitly required server acceptance without the removed checkbox and a one-click customer path.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner asked for a complete urgent checkout fix and held payment testing. This follow-up requires exact-head protected owner approval before merge and production release.
